examples.text: Er gab mir etwas Brot sowie etwas Milch.
examples.en: He gave me some bread, also some milk.
He teaches mathematics as well as English.

examples.text: Ihre Söhne sowie ihre Tochter studieren.
examples.en: Her sons as well as her daughter are in college.

examples.text: Sowie er allein gelassen wurde, öffnete er den Brief.
examples.en: As soon as he was left alone, he opened the letter.

examples.text: Die Bauchspeicheldrüse produziert Enzyme sowie Insulin.
examples.en: The pancreas produces enzymes as well as insulin.
